notes.title: Reel Run Multiplayer Update!
notes.notes: [h1]Patch Notes – New Character & Mechanics Update[/h1][h2]Say Hello to Our New Character: [b]Lumi[/b][/h2][p]Lumi has officially joined the roster! Lumi brings a light-themed moveset with flashy combos and unique mechanics.[/p][list][*][p][b]Light Attacks[/b] – Quick, flippy strikes that bounce from enemy to enemy.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Heavy Attacks[/b] – Smooth staff swings that shoot small light beams at your foes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Charged Heavy[/b] – Hold down heavy attack to channel a big light beam in front of her, firing 5 hits per second.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Finisher[/b] – A burst of light that gives Lumi a short invincibility window and creates 3 Blessings.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Blessings – Lumi’s Special Trick[/h3][list][*][p]Blessings float around Lumi (and yes, they stack).[/p][/*][*][p]Hitting an enemy or grave sends a Blessing flying into the target.[/p][/*][*][p]When it lands, it heals Lumi and then disappears.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]New Mechanic: [b]Graves[/b][/h2][p]Multiplayer sessions just got a new twist.[/p][list][*][p]In games with 3+ players, when someone goes down, they leave behind a grave.[/p][/*][*][p]If the number of graves matches the number of players in the session, the level restarts as usual.[/p][/*][/list][h3]How Graves Work[/h3][list][*][p]Downed players don’t vanish — their grave takes their place.[/p][/*][*][p]While downed, you can’t fight, only look around and pause.[/p][/*][*][p]Teammates need to damage your grave to bring you back.[/p][/*][*][p]Using a [b]Finisher[/b] on a grave revives it instantly.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Multiplayer & UI Updates[/h2][list][*][p]Added a [b]Session Browser[/b] so you can see and join available games.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now set [b]passwords[/b] to keep your sessions private.[/p][/*][*][p]Sessions can only be joined while in the hub.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Session Banners[/b] to show who’s currently in your game.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]General Fixes & Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Polished attack animations across all characters for a smoother feel.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a ton of small bugs thanks to lots of playtesting.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][previewyoutube="mZLkRHAf9NI;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Reel Run Update V1.4!
notes.notes: [h1][b]Patch Notes for Version 1.4[/b][/h1][h3][b]Over 75 Achievements to now hunt for![/b][/h3][list][*][p]Improved QOL for Character Select[/p][/*][*][p]Character Select now allows you to click on the portrait to select the character[/p][/*][*][p]Sabrina Reload SFX Implemented[/p][/*][*][p]Numerous Bug Fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Combat Polishing and QOL enhancements[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted Boss Rush Controller Rumble[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies now have more dynamic hit reactions[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies now have more cinematic death responses[/p][/*][*][p]Finisher have more dynamic targeting allowing easier use[/p][/*][*][p]Damage number readability improved[/p][/*][/list]
